basket_proposals.name: P02_PENSION_MEQ_MAG
basket_proposals.desc: Balanced-mandate month-end rebalance fade. Minus the month-to-date divergence between equity and bond sleeves (z-scored on a causal 750-session trailing scale, clipped 2.5 SD), expressed as a vol-scaled SPY-vs-IEF spread held ONLY over the last 4 sessions of the month. ~0.46x gross notional, active 19% of sessions, two trades/month.
basket_proposals.held_out: 2014-01..2026-08, 12.6 untouched years: net Sharpe +0.37 (t 1.33), +0.29 at 2x measured cost, gross +0.46. Positive net of realistic cost, individually insignificant.
basket_proposals.diversification_note: Directional equity-vs-duration overlay on a monthly cadence driven by mandated asset-allocation flow. Every BASKET1 leg (T3 overnight reversal, ETF-sibling RV, dual-class RV, T7 ex-open, T12 CEF discount, XS_GLSR_Z) is a relative-value or short-horizon reversal book. Different instruments (SPY/IEF), different holding clock (4 sessions/month, 19% duty cycle), different driver. Structural overlap near zero.
basket_proposals.disposition: forward-log only, ZERO size, against BASKET_FORWARD_LOG.jsonl; revisit at 60 rebalance events (~5 years). Design and held-out are both spent.
basket_proposals.guard: IF ever sized (not this round): SPY-vs-IEF only, <=0.5x gross, last 4 sessions of month only, z clipped at 2.5 SD. Hard kill if the SPY-only leg's trailing 12-month Sharpe goes negative, or if the design sign flips over 12 consecutive rebalances, or if realised cost exceeds 2x the modelled 1.0/2.0 bp per side.

method_corrections: Test on GROSS, size on NET: cost is sign-invariant, so best achievable net is sign*gross - cost. Ranking on net t produced four false hits with large negative net t.
Never freeze a sign before charging cost, or a shocked cost assumption can RAISE net Sharpe. Assert net_shock <= net <= gross in every sweep self-test.
Raw dividend-unadjusted price panels manufacture alpha via the ex-date drop (one formula printed a fake t=-13.97; true value -0.19). Neutralise ex-date returns on the inv3 stock panel.
Per-signal coverage belongs in the self-test: a conditional up/down-day beta silently had 0.000 coverage from a 250d window with default minobs=W//2.
Exclude zero-notional days rather than scoring them as zero-return days, or long group warm-ups deflate t-stats.
recommendations: Promote nothing. Basket unchanged: T3, ETF-sibling RV, dual-class RV, T7 ex-open, T12 CEF, XS_GLSR_Z (decaying, logging-only).
Log P02_PENSION_MEQ_MAG forward at zero size; revisit at 60 rebalance events.
Stop re-mining the daily US equity cross-section on free data; the binding constraint is execution cost, not signal discovery.
Stop re-mining the daily crypto spot cross-section; buying data does not move a wall where the effect is already measured and smaller than the fee.
Vol term structure is the only theme worth re-opening, and only with real VX futures settlements or intraday curve sampling.
